text: APPROVE. The patch moves the directory listing, file reading and subdirectory queueing into three helpers with the same control flow, including `continue`, `break` and the post-read `maxFiles` check. `Files` is left with only the loop and a few branches, well under 15, and I see nothing that would break the warnings-as-errors build. This is from reading the diff only; I haven't built it or run the analyzer.
